parsed.explanation: Visa and border are documented non-discriminatory, X/changed markers accepted if issued; no active traveler criminalisation or facility ban. Broad social acceptance, service-protection law, bathroom access and health-care climate support reduced risk. The main visitor-facing institutional exposure is custody: placement is ungoverned, tied to municipal gender records/physical features, and trans detainees are often sent to protective wings with sex offenders, with documented intimidation and assault; courts note harm but no effective rule exists. Violence/report counts lack denominators and comparator, and low convictions show incomplete recourse rather than a campaign. Resident self-ID gaps do not offset these facts; net sits below strong-reduced profiles at 0.68.
